fields.title: Design the Access Model
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: A network of 25 stores, three regional directorates, central accounting, and an external auditor once a year. Propose roles, scopes, and constraints.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: roles — employee, store manager, regional director, accountant, auditor. Scopes — store, region, network. Toggle constraints — 'without customer personal data' for accountant and auditor, 'read-only' for auditor. Auditor — time-limited guest access. Plus delegation for managers during vacation and temporary access for our support team. An attribute-based model is not needed.
